newsitem.title: USA: Community Redevelopment, D&B talks end.
newsitem.headline: Community Redevelopment, D&B talks end.

text.p: Home remodelling services company Community Redevelopment Corp said on Tuesday that talks regarding a possible merger with D&B Tile Distributors had ended.

Community signed a letter of intent on September 27 to merge with D&B, one of the largest tile distributors in south Florida. But after further consideration, Community said it will not proceed with the negotiations.
Community said it planned to continue actively seeking other acquisitions as part of its planned growth strategy.
